messages:
morgan: Starting canary rollout of release v2026.3 to 5% traffic in us-west-2. Rolling now — tagging @oncall. I'll watch the canary for 15m.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release=v2026.3 target=canary(5%) region=us-west-2 run_id=run-8231 link=https://deploys.internal/runs/run-8231 :rocket:

ash: looks ok at +1m, no obvious 5xx in logs yet

oncall-bot: Pager: HIGH 5xx rate detected for svc=model-inference (canary) — 5xx_rate=4.2% (threshold=1.0%) — triggered at 3176543228 :rotating_light:

raj: seeing 503 spikes and median latency x3 on canary tasks. stack traces show kv cache NPEs in canary containers.

morgan: copy. rolling a kill for the release flag 'release_2026_3' now to stop new traffic into the canary. doing safe flip via flag service.

deploy-bot: Feature flag flipped: release_2026_3 -> OFF (actor=morgan) — traffic will switch to stable immediately. link=https://flags.internal/flags/release_2026_3 :white_check_mark:

sara: starting rollback of canary deployment to previous revision to be safe. Command I ran: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/model-inference --to-revision=42```

ash: canary traffic down to 0.9% and falling, a couple residual 5xx from older pods being terminated. scaling down canary replicaSet.

raj: handing off — I'm oncall but need to step out in 20m. Summary for next person: kill-switch executed, rollback in progress, observed customer impact ~2% of requests experienced elevated errors during ~3m window. No SLA breaches yet but SLO burn small spike. CS alerted. @dave please take continuity.

dave: ack. I'll monitor the rollback and run smoke tests once pods settle. Running quick smoke: ``curl -sS https://canary-check.internal/health || echo FAIL``

monitoring-bot: Alert update: 5xx rate declining — baseline restored to 0.12% at 3176543278. Metrics: https://metrics.internal/org/model-inference?from=3176543200&to=3176543280 — incident status: mitigated.

dave: rollback confirmed complete, canary RS gone, traffic normalized. Will open a follow-up ticket for RCA + make sure the flag evaluation path is hardened. cc @product-team. :white_check_mark:

morgan: thanks all — good mitigation. next steps: rca runbook, check canary test coverage for kv cache edge-case, and schedule postmortem.
